abilities.name: Critical Mass
abilities.description: Getting a Takedown will refresh the cooldown on all of Li-Ming's Abilities.; trait

abilities.name: Magic Missiles
abilities.description: Fire three missiles toward an area, each dealing 147 damage to the first enemy hit. These missiles do 50% damage to Structures.

fields.notes: Damage reduction against Structures stacks additively with offensive damage modifiers.

abilities.name: Arcane Orb
abilities.description: Fire an orb that powers up as it travels, dealing 135 damage to the first enemy hit. Damage is increased the farther it travels, up to 270 more damage.

fields.notes: Upon hitting a target the Orb explodes, dealing area damage. Units that are immune to skillshots cannot trigger the explosion, but can be damaged by it. Hit detection radius is increased by 0.09 and damage is increased by 16.875 every 0.0625 seconds the orb travels. Arcane Orb 's damage can increase up to 16 times, causing it to reach its maximum damage after travelling for 1.0 second (9.0 range).
As a teleport-type Movement Ability, Teleport can disjoint most projectiles.

abilities.name: Disintegrate
abilities.description: Channel a powerful beam, dealing 480 damage over 2.6 seconds to enemies while they are in it. The direction of the beam changes with your mouse cursor position.; 20; 80; Heroic

fields.props: Area of Effect, Clamping, Stationary channel

abilities.name: Wave of Force
abilities.description: Knock away all enemies from an area and deal 160 damage.; 30; 80; Heroic

talents.name: Force Armor
talents.description: When Magic Missiles damages an enemy Hero, gain 50 Spell Armor against the next enemy Ability, reducing the damage taken by 50%. Can only gain 1 charge per cast, up to 4 charges maximum. Passive Li Ming's Mana regeneration is increased by 100% while below 35% Mana.

fields.notes: Does not stack with itself or other positive Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack.

talents.name: Aether Walker
talents.description: Teleport costs no Mana. If Li-Ming hasn't taken damage in the last 3 seconds, Teleport's cooldown is decreased by 2 seconds. Casting Teleport causes Li-Ming's next cast of Magic Missiles to deal 10% bonus damage.

fields.notes: Does not stack with itself. Stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Magic Missiles 's damage.

talents.name: Power Hungry
talents.description: Regeneration Globes restore 100% more Mana and grant 10% Spell Power for 20 seconds.

fields.notes: Does not stack with itself. Subsequent Globes refresh the duration. Stacks additively with other sources of Spell Power as well as other offensive damage modifiers affecting Li-Ming's Spell Damage.

talents.name: Zei's Vengeance
talents.description: Increase Arcane Orb's damage increase for distance traveled by 30%. Additionally, reduce its cooldown by 1 second.

fields.notes: Cooldown reduction is permanent. Only affects the distance-based portion of Arcane Orb 's damage, effectively increasing Arcane Orb 's total damage by up to 20%. Stacks multiplicatively with other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Arcane Orb 's damage.

talents.name: Tal Rasha's Elements
talents.description: Casting Abilities increases the damage of the next Ability by 5%, up to a maximum of 20%. This bonus is reset when the same Ability is used within a chain.

fields.notes: Damage bonus is added and validated after the Ability has been cast. In case the bonus is reset, the Ability that reset the bonus still benefits from the damage increase. Using any Ability twice within a 4 Ability chain resets the bonus. Upon reaching 20% bonus, the next Ability used resets the bonus. Stacks additively with itself and other offensive damage modifiers that can affect the cast Ability's damage.

_raw_fields: Casting Abilities increases the damage of the next Ability by 5%, up to a maximum of 20%. This bonus is reset when the same Ability is used within a chain.

talents.name: Archon: Pure Power
talents.description: cooldown 10 / 1.0 Active Activate to enter Archon form, allowing Li-Ming to repeatedly use Disintegrate, but be unable to cast other Abilities.

fields.notes: Archon form lasts indefinitely once cast and can be disabled by reactivating the Ability. Cooldown starts upon leaving Archon form. Entering Archon form replaces Wave of Force and Disintegrate with Archon's Disintegrate, which has no Mana cost and can be freely toggled on and off. Archon's Disintegrate has a separate cooldown from normal Disintegrate. Li-Ming is unable to mount while in Archon form.
